name: Living Book

primary.name: Paper Cut
primary.description: Slash a sharp paper edge in a close 105-degree arc: 25 damage, 86 reach.

secondary.name: Flying Pages
secondary.description: Hold secondary to release seeking pages every 0.22s for 11 damage each. Half prioritise the nearest visible enemy; the rest cycle through other visible enemies in range. You cannot move or dodge and take 30% more damage while open. Release to stop.

passive: Quick Reading: primary cooldown reduced by 20%.

technique.name: Walking Library
technique.description: Move at 30% speed while channeling. Pages release every 0.30s instead of 0.22s and deal 15% less damage. Extra damage taken remains.

final_technique.name: Dog-Eared Blades
final_technique.description: Two folded page blades curl out and return. A target takes 12 damage at most once on each leg. Longer reach; slower than Paper Cut.

attack.name: Dog-Eared Blades
attack.description: Two folded page blades curl out and return. A target takes 12 damage at most once on each leg. Longer reach; slower than Paper Cut.
